comment: Entries here must work from a fresh clone. Configurations that point at checkouts on one specific machine (absolute paths, private repositories) belong in .claude/launch.local.json, which is gitignored - the Pulse app and its design-system worktree used to be listed here and leaked their real paths, which is exactly what the *.private.md rule exists to prevent.

configurations.comment: This is a WORKTREE, so it must not share 5173 with the primary checkout: Playwright's reuseExistingServer would silently attach to whichever server got there first and measure the other checkout. Pair with PARITY_PORT=5273.
configurations.name: showcase-worktree
